segments.source: Compare Forty-Six in your regular milk drink without increasing the dose just because it is a dark roast. If you enjoy the chocolate-led direction but the drink seems too concentrated, adjust dilution first. If the roast character itself is unwelcome, move toward Big Trouble rather than spending the rest of a large bag trying to turn Forty-Six into a lighter coffee.

segments.source: Make Hologram in the drink you buy beans for most often, then try a smaller milk portion if that is a latte. The question is whether the fruit-and-chocolate direction remains enjoyable in your normal serving. If you prefer it only black but rarely drink black coffee, that is a reason to choose a different daily blend rather than a bigger Hologram bag.

segments.source: The two-hole stainless wand makes milk a manual skill. Brewing and steaming share a small dual-use boiler, so make the coffee, raise the temperature for milk and follow the manual’s refill and return-to-brew sequence. Several cappuccinos expose this transition more than one occasional drink.

segments.source: Three rocker switches make the current E24 easy to understand but leave the owner responsible for timing. Its appeal is a traditional learning station whose separate grinder can be improved independently. If repeat milk rounds are the daily order, compare a dual boiler before paying for accessories and later wishing away the transition.
